messages:
alex: Heads-up — Customer Z asked for an accelerated regional cutover plan. They want feature-flag slices + canary windows instead of a big flip. Can we sketch a safe timetable and rollback policy?

maria: +1 to slices. My proposal: 3 waves — 1% (30m), 10% (3h), 100% (24h). Telemetry gates after each wave. Keep default model pinned until final wave. :white_check_mark:

sam: Question: what telemetry gates? latency p50/p95, error_rate, and quality delta? Also worried about spike during 10% -> 100% step. Suggest an interim 50% if metrics look noisy.

jun: Agreed on gates. Propose concrete thresholds: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.3%, quality_delta <= 1.5% (regression). If any gate fails for 5m, auto-fallback to previous variant.

casey: FYI legal requires tenant opt-in docs for Customer Z (they're on Dedicated). We need an opt-in flag and a pre-roll KMS check. Ops needs the exact tenant list before wave 1.

leo: For rollout mechanics, recommend: shadow traffic x24h for EU region, then start wave 1. Shadowing helps warm caches. Also add a short warmup window for KV caches.

alex: Good call on shadowing. Can we capture the flag config as a small example?

maria: Example flag yaml snippet:

```
flag: customer_z_regional_cutover
variants:
  - control (current model)
  - candidate (downgraded / quantized variant)
slices:
  - wave_1: 1%
  - wave_2: 10%
  - wave_3: 100%
gates:
  - latency_p50: 120ms
  - latency_p95: 350ms
  - error_rate: 0.3%
  - quality_delta: 1.5%
auto_fallback: true
fallback_variant: control
```

sam: One more ops constraint — ensure route-level token quotas are preserved during waves. If token budget for candidate exceeds X, fail the wave.

jun: Also add timebox: if a wave is in-progress > 6h without meeting final stability (low variance), mark for manual review and pause further waves.

casey: Customer asked for per-tenant opt-in via UI. That means our rollout must support tenant-scoped flags and a way for CS to toggle. Can product own the toggle UX?

alex: Product can own the UX but need a clear handoff doc for CS + Ops. I'll draft a short runbook. Owners: maria (rollout config + gates), sam (ops constraints + quotas), jun (auto-fallback logic + thresholds), casey (tenant opt-in + legal checks), leo (shadow + warmup).

opsbot: Deploy-bot: noted — shadow job scheduled for eu-warmup at 2026-04-02T08:00Z. Will post results to #eng-oncall.

maria: For experiments/A-B: let's run the candidate as an A treatment on 10% wave for 48h, compare quality metrics (BLEU/embedding-sim/ctr depending on surface). If regression > 1.5% stop.

leo: Rollforward policy: if all gates green for 2 consecutive windows (30m each) proceed. Rollback policy: immediate rollback if p95 breaches threshold for 2 consecutive 5m buckets or error_rate spikes > 1% sustained 5m. Manual override allowed by owners.

alex: Final checklist before kickoff:
- tenant list from CS (casey)
- KMS/legal signoff (casey)
- shadow results (leo)
- flag yaml + rollout config (maria)
- quota/route checks (sam)
- runbook + manual rollback steps (alex)

casey: I'll get tenant list and legal signoff by EOD. Putting a calendar sync with CS & Ops now.

maria: I'll open a tech PR with the flag config and a small test harness for the gates.

ajun: small typo, we use jun (no a) — will own auto-fallback infra tests.

alex: thanks all. If anyone sees a blocker, ping me. We'll aim to start shadowing Tuesday and wave 1 Wednesday morning. :rocket:
